patient_no_shows.name: Patient no-shows and last-minute cancellations
typical_causes: No automated appointment reminders
Single-channel reminder only (phone or email)
No cancellation waitlist to fill gaps
Patients forget appointments booked weeks in advance
effective_solutions: Weave multi-channel reminders (text, email, phone)
Lighthouse 360 automated confirmation sequences
AI predictive no-show identification and overbooking
Two-way texting for easy rescheduling

insurance_verification_burden.name: Time-consuming manual insurance verification
typical_causes: Phone-based verification with insurance companies
4-6 hours per day spent on verification calls
Frequent plan changes and coverage updates
No real-time eligibility checking
effective_solutions: Vyne Dental automated eligibility verification
Dental Intelligence real-time insurance checks
Batch verification before appointment day
Integration with practice management for auto-posting

low_treatment_acceptance.name: Low treatment plan acceptance rates
typical_causes: Poor visual communication of treatment needs
Cost shock without financing options presented
Patients not understanding urgency of treatment
Only 30-50% of presented plans accepted
effective_solutions: Pearl AI visual treatment presenters with intraoral imagery
Sunbit and CareCredit financing presented at chairside
AI-generated treatment animations and before/after visuals
Automated follow-up sequences for pending treatment plans

recall_compliance.name: Poor recall and hygiene appointment compliance
typical_causes: 40-60% of patients overdue for hygiene visits
Manual recall tracking via spreadsheets or reports
Generic one-size-fits-all recall messaging
No systematic follow-up for overdue patients
effective_solutions: Lighthouse 360 automated recall campaigns
Solutionreach personalized multi-touch recall sequences
AI-driven risk-based recall scheduling
Automated reactivation campaigns for lapsed patients

manual_appointment_scheduling.name: Phone-dependent manual appointment scheduling
typical_causes: 3-5 hours per day spent on phone scheduling
No online booking available for patients
Missed calls during lunch or after hours
Inefficient schedule utilization and gaps
effective_solutions: NexHealth online booking with PM integration
LocalMed real-time availability and self-scheduling
Weave online scheduling with automated confirmations
AI-optimized schedule fill for gap management

front_desk_phone_overload.name: Front desk overwhelmed by phone volume
typical_causes: 50% or more of front desk day spent on phone
Calls for scheduling, insurance, directions, hours
Missed calls during peak times losing new patients
Staff unable to focus on in-office patient experience
effective_solutions: Smith.ai AI voice receptionist for overflow calls
Weave missed-call auto-texting
IVR system routing common questions to self-service
Online FAQ and chatbot for routine inquiries

clinical_documentation.name: Time-consuming clinical charting and documentation
typical_causes: Manual charting after each patient visit
Inconsistent documentation across providers
Time spent on narrative notes reducing chair time
Compliance documentation requirements
effective_solutions: Voice-to-chart AI dictation (Bola AI)
Template-based charting with auto-population
AI clinical note generation from structured data
Automated perio charting from digital probing

billing_collections.name: Poor collection rates and aging accounts receivable
typical_causes: No automated payment follow-up workflows
Patients leaving without paying co-pays
Manual statement generation and mailing
A/R aging beyond 90 days
effective_solutions: Automated payment plan setup at checkout
Text-to-pay and online payment portals
Automated collection sequences by aging bucket
CareCredit and Sunbit integration for large balances

new_patient_acquisition.name: High cost of new patient acquisition
typical_causes: Acquisition cost of EUR 150-350 per new patient
Few online reviews compared to competitors
Poor local SEO and Google Business Profile
No systematic referral program
effective_solutions: Birdeye or Podium automated review request campaigns
Google Business Profile optimization with AI
Automated referral tracking and reward programs
Weave review management integrated with PM system

staff_turnover.name: High staff turnover and burnout
typical_causes: 25% average annual staff turnover in dental
Repetitive administrative tasks causing burnout
Understaffing leading to overtime and stress
Training costs for new hires on complex workflows
effective_solutions: Workflow automation reducing repetitive admin tasks
Better scheduling tools for work-life balance
Cross-training enabled by standardized digital processes
AI-assisted onboarding and training documentation

inventory_management.name: Inefficient dental supply inventory management
typical_causes: Expired supplies discovered at point of use
Stockouts of critical materials causing procedure delays
Manual counting and reordering processes
No usage tracking tied to procedures performed
effective_solutions: Automated reorder point systems
Usage tracking tied to procedure codes
Expiration date monitoring with alerts
Vendor comparison and group purchasing integration

patient_communication_gaps.name: Gaps in patient follow-up and communication
typical_causes: Manual post-treatment follow-ups often missed
No automated post-op care instructions
Patients unclear on pre-appointment preparation
Lack of two-way communication channel
effective_solutions: Automated post-treatment instruction delivery via text
Two-way texting with 98% open rate vs 20% email
Pre-appointment preparation reminders
Automated birthday and milestone messaging

common_blockers: Provider preference and chair assignment logic
FDA regulatory considerations for AI diagnostics
HIPAA-compliant data transfer to PM system
Segmentation of recall vs reactivation patients
Staff adoption of review request workflows

effective_patterns.pattern: Automated multi-channel appointment reminders (text, email, voice) reduce no-shows by 30-50%
effective_patterns.recommendation: Deploy Weave or Lighthouse 360 with 3-touch reminder sequence (7-day, 2-day, same-day)

effective_patterns.pattern: Online scheduling captures 15-25% of appointments after hours when phones are off
effective_patterns.recommendation: Implement NexHealth or LocalMed online booking integrated with practice management system

effective_patterns.pattern: Automated insurance verification saves 15-20 hours per week per front desk staff member
effective_patterns.recommendation: Deploy Vyne Dental batch verification the day before appointments to eliminate phone-based checks

effective_patterns.pattern: Patient financing options presented at chairside increase treatment acceptance by 20-40%
effective_patterns.recommendation: Integrate Sunbit or CareCredit into treatment presentation workflow with tablet-based applications

effective_patterns.pattern: Automated review request campaigns generate 5-10x more online reviews than manual asking
effective_patterns.recommendation: Deploy Birdeye or Podium with automatic post-appointment review requests via text message

effective_patterns.pattern: Two-way texting achieves 98% open rate vs 20% email open rate for patient communication
effective_patterns.recommendation: Implement Weave or Solutionreach two-way texting as primary patient communication channel

effective_patterns.pattern: AI-assisted imaging analysis provides second opinion and increases treatment acceptance by 10-15%
effective_patterns.recommendation: Deploy Pearl or Overjet for AI-powered radiograph analysis to support case presentation

anti_patterns: Custom practice management software build -- existing PM systems (Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental) are mature, deeply integrated, and heavily regulated
Custom AI diagnostic imaging solution -- FDA 510(k) approval requirements make custom dental AI infeasible for individual practices
Full practice management system replacement during busy season -- migrate in phases starting with the least disruptive modules
AI chatbots for clinical dental questions -- liability exposure and HIPAA compliance concerns outweigh marginal convenience gains
Replacing phone system without staff training and buy-in -- adoption fails and staff reverts to old workflows within weeks
Building a custom patient portal when practice management and communication vendors provide integrated solutions
Implementing all automation tools simultaneously -- start with highest-impact quick wins (reminders, online scheduling) before layering complexity
Using consumer-grade messaging tools (WhatsApp, iMessage) for patient communication -- HIPAA violations and no audit trail
